title: Uvavanyo lweLiwa Elingenazintuli
intro: Uluntu, olunezakhono neqhayiya, lwayikrola ilifa labo ezintabeni kanye. Kodwa xa kwathunyelwa uphawu olucacileyo kubo, uvavanyo lokholo nokuzibamba, ukuzikhukhumeza kwabo kwabakhokelela kwindlela yokungabuyeli. Ungalibona eli qela kunye nemiphumo yokungavumi kwabo?
clues: Sasingoochwephesha bamatye, siqopha izindlu ezintle ngqo kwiintaba.
Isithunywa esivela kubantu bakuthi seza kuthi, sisibizela ukuba sinqule uThixo oNyanisekileyo.
Safuna umqondiso wokuqinisekisa amazwi akhe, kwaza kwaveliswa isidalwa esikhethekileyo njengovavanyo kuthi.
Sanikwa umyalelo olula: ukuba sabelane ngomthombo wamanzi wethu nesi sidalwa, sisivumele sisele ngosuku lwaso olumiselweyo.
Ngenxa yokuzikhukhumeza kwethu, bambalwa phakathi kwethu abaceba iyelenqe kwaye sazichasa isilumkiso, sabulala isidalwa esasifanele ukuba ngumqondiso wethu.
Sanikwa iintsuku ezintathu ngaphambi kokutshatyalaliswa kwethu, kwaza kwabakho uqhushumbo olukhulu emakhayeni ethu, lwasishiya singenabomi saza sabhukuqwa.

location.label: Yayiyintoni eyona nto iphambili kwibali lethu?

arabic: فَعَقَرُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةَ وَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰصَـٰلِحُ ٱئْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers." (7:77)
